senses.sense_definition: The person responsible for handling the accounts on a ship, or for dealing with the passengers on a ship or aircraft.

examples.text: The <w>purser</w> helped the passengers find their cabins after they boarded the cruise ship.
The captain instructed the <w>purser</w> to finalize the ship's financial records before arriving at the port.

senses.sense_definition: A surname originating as an occupation for a maker of purses.

examples.text: The historian discovered that the <w>Purser</w> family had lived in this village for over three centuries.
Many people named <w>Purser</w> can trace their ancestry back to medieval leather workers.

traits.comment: This word is used as a family name.
